name: Ryuugamine Mikado
source:
A first years high school boy who moved to Ikebukuro thanks to encouragement from his best friend, Masaomi Kida. He moved in hopes of having a more exciting life than the one he lived in Saitama. He seems to be infatuated with Anri, but has never found a chance to tell her. 

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Durarara!!_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
